findings.summary: No audit-chain row emitted for the oya-vcs-admission dir-move in PR-12. The existing OYA-VCS-ADMISSION-CUTOVER-2026-05-15 rows predate this PR and document the original cutover, not the path reorganisation from deploy/gitops/ to infra/kyverno/. ADR-0003 establishes audit-chain as the append-only event stream for changeset evidence; a structural path change affecting a live Argo config value qualifies as an emittable event.
findings.recommended_action: Append a row to evidence/audit-chain.jsonl with event_type='oya_vcs_admission_path_consolidation', change_id scoped to PR-12 (e.g. 'OYA-HYGIENE-PR12-KYVERNO-CONSOLIDATION-2026-05-16'), and payload referencing the new infra/kyverno/ path and ADR-0117.
